articles.title: About me
articles.contents:
I am a computational biologist/data scientist/bioinformatician/bioengineer who enjoys learning from complex biological data sets and collaborating. (My pronouns are she/her.)
I am currently the Chief Operating Officer at Synthesize Bio My prior professional experience includes roles at Pathos, Bristol Myers Squibb, and Janssen (Johnson & Johnson). My work sits at the intersection of machine learning, molecular data, and drug development. I have led teams across all stages of drug development, from target identification through approval. Google Scholar page.
I was a founding organizer of the Philadelphia chapter of R-Ladies.
I live in the Philadelphia area. I spend my free time watching television and improving my artistic skills through painting, quilting, and other creative pursuits.
You can find me online on LinkedIn and GitHub.
